ideas.pitch: An edge-computed veterinary triage app that uses smartphone cameras and audio analysis to detect pet distress and route emergency alerts to local vets.
ideas.title: PetPulsar Emergency AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the co-organizer PetsParivar's core domain and features a working computer vision triage demo inspired by clinical-grade AI platforms.

ideas.pitch: A behavioral analytics platform that combines IoT bin sensors and a walk-to-earn mobile web app to gamify and measure waste segregation compliance on campus.
ideas.problem_statement: Students need better ways to understand why people do not follow existing waste-segregation practices.
ideas.title: EcoNudge Campus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines clear, measurable environmental impact metrics with a live-working civic rewards interface that judges can test instantly on their phones.

ideas.pitch: A smart matchmaking portal for animal shelters that uses a questionnaire-based multi-agent recommendation model to pair prospective owners with rescue pets based on lifestyle.
ideas.title: PawMatch Behavioral Sync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets PetsParivar's sponsor interest in animal welfare by applying multi-agent RAG workflow logic to streamline institutional adoption rates.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first emergency response P2P web application allowing students to broadcast encrypted distress signals and live locations across campus dead zones.
ideas.title: CampusSafe AI Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a critical, high-anxiety campus problem with hard engineering in local network protocols and immediate, demonstrable live safety utility.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered browser extension that dynamically converts complex academic portal documents into structured text-to-speech audio streams and simplified dyslexia-friendly layouts.
ideas.title: EduAccess Lens
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers immediate social impact and high inclusive accessibility value with a lightweight client-side script that can be demoed live in under two minutes.
